Used that plus Section 4.1/4.2/4.4 to produce answer.md following the skill's exact Output template: Quick Answer, Details, Exceptions/Special Cases, Who to Contact, and Source (citing employee_handbook.md, Section 4, subsections 4.1 and 4.3). Verified the answer's claims trace directly to quoted handbook text and that the required citation/contact/exception fields are all populated, matching the skill's guardrails (cite source, note exceptions, point to a contact).
